_comment: Engine room (#297). Every number is a starting value, TODO(initiator). There is no automatic shutdown: the reactor melts when left hot, and SCRAM is the operator's. reactor: the reactor (fission and turbine 0..100, output kW). auto_turbine_speed and auto_fission_speed are the Auto controller's target change per second: the turbine follows the load faster than fission is cut, so a load drop overshoots. decay_heat is the residual heat (degrees) that only the coolant takes away: without flow the core climbs whatever Auto does. coolant_coast_s is how long the flow takes to run down or come back after the pump stops or is repaired. temp_stiffness and temp_damping make the temperature a damped spring towards its target (#300: a correction takes seconds, a step overshoots by about a quarter); heat_output_factor is the heat the delivered output makes at full output (degrees), and fission_lag_s the time constant with which fission follows its target (Barotrauma 1 s). condition is the reactor's own device values (its repair line 50, wear floor 10, the floor is clamped to the broken limit); the pump and the junction box wear to 50 with repair at 80 (Barotrauma style: wear asks for repair, it never breaks a device). room: the coolant pump and the junction box use the device values (device_core: max, repair_threshold, broken_below, factor_at_broken, fix times in s, required_skill, fail_chance, fail_cost, fail_lockout_s, wear_rate, wear_floor, wear_delay_s as a [from, to] range, idle_wear, overload_wear). grid: demand kW at full work, priority (higher is served first) and min_ratio (0..1, the share below which the group switches off). A group's breaker is on or off in play, not in this file. coolant_* are the pump's tank: use in percent per second (base, and per unit of reactor heat at full flow), the LOW line, and what one canister adds.
